html:
G'oya

Ketma-ket tashriflar orasidagi tanaffus bu har tashrif bilan undan oldingisi orasidagi farq. Oldingi tashrif sanasini LAG beradi, faqat o'tkazilgan qabullar ichida va har bemor uchun alohida. Keyin bemor bo'yicha guruhlab, eng katta farqni olamiz.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da ikki sananing ayirmasi butun son, kunlar soni:

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH v AS (
  SELECT patient_id, appt_date,
         LAG(appt_date) OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY appt_date) AS prev_date
  FROM appointments
  WHERE status = 'done'
)
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.name, MAX(v.appt_date - v.prev_date) AS max_gap_days
FROM v
JOIN patients p ON p.id = v.patient_id
WHERE v.prev_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY max_gap_days DESC, p.id

SQLite'da sana matn. Kunlar farqini julianday ayirmasi beradi:

Faqat SQLiteWITH v AS (
  SELECT patient_id, appt_date,
         LAG(appt_date) OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY appt_date) AS prev_date
  FROM appointments
  WHERE status = 'done'
)
SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p.name,
       MAX(CAST(julianday(v.appt_date) - julianday(v.prev_date) AS INTEGER)) AS max_gap_days
FROM v
JOIN patients p ON p.id = v.patient_id
WHERE v.prev_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY max_gap_days DESC, p.id

WHERE v.prev_date IS NOT NULL har bemorning birinchi tashrifini olib tashlaydi. Bitta tashrifli bemorda boshqa qator qolmaydi va u natijaga tushmaydi.

status sharti LAG dan oldin, CTE ichida bo'lishi kerak. Aks holda bekor qilingan qabul "oldingi tashrif" bo'lib qoladi: Malikaning 5-yanvar va 15-mart orasidagi 70 kunlik tanaffusi ikkiga bo'linadi.

Tuzoqlar

Birinchi va oxirgi tashrif farqi (MAX - MIN) eng uzun tanaffus emas. Aziz uchun u 82 kun, tanaffuslar esa 30 va 52.

SQLite'da appt_date - prev_date xato bermaydi. Matnlar songa aylantiriladi, '2024-03-15' dan 2024 qoladi, va bir yil ichidagi har qanday ikki sana farqi 0 chiqadi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da DATE - DATE butun son beradi, TIMESTAMP - TIMESTAMP esa interval. SQLite'da julianday kasr son qaytaradi, sanalar uchun farq butun bo'ladi, lekin CAST(... AS INTEGER) natijani 52.0 emas, 52 qilib chiqaradi.
